study.question: Does minibatch-specific oriented auxiliary information in the paired tangent Q improve click AUC beyond its unoriented line, magnitude and unsigned click/native projection geometry?
study.hypothesis: Initial joint versus click-only AUC was 0.6684573079 versus 0.6678548721, but later failures of purportedly equivalent replays and FP32 collection show numerical path sensitivity. In g3-r0050, tangent +/-Q scored 0.6683166124/0.6679704659 (gap 0.0003461465), while native +/-O scored 0.6682887436/0.6677657645. Thus native-direction overlap is not necessary for this single-seed sign gap. However Q is odd under simultaneous auxiliary-cotangent sign reversal, so the tangent still carries auxiliary orientation. Hypothesis: this batch-specific orientation contributes useful transfer. Canonicalize the sign of Q using its first largest-absolute flattened coordinate, preserving the same line and norm but making canonical Q even under auxiliary reversal at fixed click cotangent and model state. If paired +Q cannot reproducibly outperform both canonical orientations, useful oriented information beyond the unsigned line is unsupported. This is an attribution experiment, not an expected improvement over the incumbent.

study.proposed_difference: Let j be the first argmax of abs(flatten(Q)); s=+1 if Q[j]>=0 else -1 (all-zero Q uses +1). Define U=sQ. Q(-G)=-Q(G), but U(-G)=U(G) at fixed K, occupied support and state, subject to finite-precision tie behavior. Compare +/-U with +/-Q in a 2x2 orientation-source by sign factorial. Every cell computes U and both negative directions before selection. Canonicalization changes no module, forward probability, private gradient or norm at fixed state. It is a prescribed first-order surrogate VJP, not a scalar-objective derivative.
predictions: Integrity prerequisite: paired_positive_bridge and paired_negative_bridge reproduce g3-r0050-tangent_positive and g3-r0050-tangent_negative under the same protocol; compare full task metrics and slices, not only rounded click AUC. Any unexplained difference above 1e-7 AUC suspends attribution.

Primary predeclared contrast D=AUC(paired_positive_bridge)-max(AUC(canonical_positive),AUC(canonical_negative)). Useful batch-specific orientation predicts D>0, with D>=1e-4 a practical screening threshold only. Also report both component contrasts, canonical and paired sign gaps and their difference; do not claim significance from this seed.

At fixed synthetic/host state: U is exactly +/-Q, U(-G)=U(G), Q(-G)=-Q(G), norm/support/centering/orthogonality preserved to inherited precision; all-empty/zero-K/zero-O/degenerate cases stay finite. Private parameter gradients and forward outputs equal across cells before trajectories diverge.

No added parameters (expected 32192421 total, 399205 dense), inference operations or inference-state changes. Small backward argmax/gather overhead must be measured, not assumed free. All four AUC/Logloss, slices, measured train/allocated/wall costs, memory and inference metrics remain required.
falsifiers: If either canonical orientation matches/exceeds paired +Q reproducibly at the practical threshold, oriented auxiliary sign is not needed beyond the retained unsigned geometry under this intervention. A canonical sign advantage alone can reflect coordinate/order bias.

If paired +/- fails to replay or the tensor parity/private-gradient/forward/norm gates fail, this implementation is inadmissible evidence for orientation; retain cost and receipt and diagnose before further interpretation.

A large canonical sign imbalance without paired superiority supports a coordinate/sign-schedule explanation, not informative auxiliary orientation. Similar gaps in both sources leave attribution unresolved.

No improvement over the incumbent is claimed; neither the current single-seed evidence nor this factorial establishes parameter-space gradient interference, generalization beyond official_offline visibility, production causality or priority.

Pivot coordinate depends on batch ordering, feature coordinate convention and near-tie rounding; canonical signs need not be balanced.
Training trajectories, sparse repeated-ID accumulation, Adagrad state and dense clipping diverge; row-space geometry does not imply parameter/update-space geometry.
